title: Clinical outcomes of PRESERFLO® Microshunt procedure with mitomycin C alone versus with mitomycin C and bevacizumab

license.statement: CC BY-NC 4.0 (article <license>); not CC BY, so the record is private

indication: glaucoma uncontrolled or progressing despite maximum tolerated medical therapy: mostly POAG, also secondary OAG (pseudoexfoliation, pigment dispersion), PACG, NTG and juvenile OAG (Table 1)
design: retrospective single-surgeon cohort; MMC-alone eyes operated 2018-2020, MMC plus bevacizumab eyes 2020-2022 (sequential, non-randomized)

groups.description: PreserFlo MicroShunt with sub-Tenon mitomycin C plus intracameral bevacizumab at the end of surgery (investigational adjunct)
PreserFlo MicroShunt with sub-Tenon mitomycin C alone (study control group)

series.notes: mean (SD); per-visit n not reported (analysis limited to eyes completing 6 months of follow-up); eyes that received 5-FU injections, needling or bleb revision remain in the means

notes: Completers analysis: patients who did not complete 6 months of follow-up were excluded (one patient in the bevacizumab group lost to relocation); this is loss to follow-up, not an outcome-defined selection.
Preoperative IOP on glaucoma medication (maximum tolerated medical therapy; some patients switched to preservative-free drops or oral acetazolamide while awaiting surgery).
Medication: mean (SD) number of medications at each time point is tabulated in Table 2; not extracted.
